label: CA-7(6)
title: Automation Support for Monitoring

statement.prose: Ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of monitoring results for the system using {{ insert: param, ca-07.06_odp }}.

guidance: Using automated tools for monitoring helps to maintain the accuracy, currency, and availability of monitoring information which in turns helps to increase the level of ongoing awareness of the system security and privacy posture in support of organizational risk management decisions.

params.label: automated mechanisms
guidelines: automated mechanisms used to ensure the accuracy, currency, and availability of monitoring results for the system are defined;
